risks.title: API observation/IP trust
risks.scenario: Network exposure with observe or shared proxy identity.
risks.controls: Enforce rejects unknown clients; credential identities available.
risks.next_action: Set enforce and locked policy; separate client tokens.
risks.validation_gap: V1: proxy/IP behavior needs deployment tests.

risks.title: Control behind a local proxy
risks.scenario: Proxy enters the unauthenticated loopback exception.
risks.controls: Network bindings without users deny access.
risks.next_action: Require Control users even behind a local proxy.
risks.validation_gap: V2: verify actual proxy and local exception.

risks.title: Admin browser attacks
risks.scenario: Cross-site admin request or same-origin compromise.
risks.controls: Non-simple header and Fetch Metadata checks.
risks.validation_gap: V3: real browser tests still required.

risks.title: Concrete-model authorization
risks.scenario: Role-limited client chooses a concrete model.
risks.next_action: Use explicit grants; migrate defaults separately.
risks.validation_gap: V4: full catalog and protocol coverage remains.

risks.title: Cloud classification
risks.scenario: Incorrect declaration or classifier false negative forwards sensitive data.
risks.controls: Client class floor, cloud opt-out, secret scan.
risks.next_action: Test final payload and explicit privacy exception.
risks.validation_gap: V5: end-to-end no-egress and classifier quality not proven.

risks.title: Cloud transport/destinations
risks.scenario: HTTP provider or redirect leaves approved transport/host.
risks.validation_gap: V6: HTTPS and redirect rejection remain unimplemented/unverified.

risks.title: Agent enrollment and compromise
risks.scenario: Pending-slot flood or compromised approved agent.
risks.controls: Ed25519 approval, bounded pending and per-IP admission.

risks.title: Resource and cost exhaustion
risks.scenario: Pre-auth flood, long streams or parallel costly inference.
risks.next_action: Bound pre-auth state, concurrency, time, bytes and cost.
risks.validation_gap: V12: global hostile-load budgets and unauth state still open.

risks.title: Session and memory isolation
risks.scenario: Stolen token or foreign UUID/project alias access.
risks.next_action: Test every route and token/grant rotation.
risks.validation_gap: V8: complete endpoint and deployment coverage needed.

risks.title: Memory poisoning and tool injection
risks.scenario: Shared writer injects false facts or tool instructions.
risks.next_action: Minimize writer rights; independently authorize tools.
risks.validation_gap: V9: downstream agent/tool behavior is outside unit-test coverage.

risks.title: Backend bypass and independent egress
risks.scenario: Direct backend access or its own cloud extraction.
risks.controls: Gateway-scoped grants on the router path only.
risks.next_action: Restrict backend reachability and credentials; audit backend egress.
risks.validation_gap: V5/V8: requires deployment inspection; no gateway test proves this.

risks.title: Deletion retry and restoration
risks.scenario: Old outbox/backup resurrects data; session deletion leaves memory.
risks.controls: Outbox reauthorization, tombstones and selective deletion.
risks.next_action: Define lifecycle across all stores; test crash and restore.
risks.validation_gap: V11: restore and backup policies require integration/operational tests.

risks.title: Update trust and rollback
risks.scenario: Compromised release or old valid manifest.
risks.controls: Signed agent manifest and hash; separate Ollama source/checksum.
risks.validation_gap: V13: monotone version policy is not implemented.

risks.title: Host privilege escalation impact
risks.scenario: Router/agent compromise reaches privileged host operations.
risks.next_action: Test dedicated user and separate privileged agent operations.
risks.validation_gap: V13: unprivileged deployment and recovery still need staging.

risks.title: Logs telemetry and backups
risks.scenario: Metadata/secrets leak or local audit is altered.
risks.controls: Audit intends to omit prompts and tokens.
risks.next_action: Test canaries, redaction, ACLs, rotation and backup controls.
risks.validation_gap: V14: source scan does not prove runtime-log hygiene.

risks.title: Supply chain and CI
risks.next_action: Pin/lock, scan optional dependencies and verify artifacts.
risks.validation_gap: V14: full SCA/history scan and artifact provenance remain open.
